Phantom's Embrace/Soulbind both deny a Shukuchi or Time Lapse escape, and Ink Swell discourages moving through allies with Shukuchi at all.

123.note: Ball Lightning closes on her easily given her low health/magic resistance, and repeated casts clear the trees she relies on while he attacks and dodges.

His tree-reliant kit naturally puts him near her, his tree-cutting cripples her escape options and foils Acorn Shot/Bushwhack combos, he can sit Chakram on her during a channeling Sharpshooter to force a cancel, and Timber Chain dodges Sharpshooter outright.
He can chase down a Scurry attempt, and Nature's Grasp's slow lets his team pin her down.
Nether Swap forcibly repositions her mid-Sharpshooter.
An Aghanim's Wild Axes destroys large amounts of trees she relies on.
Chaotic Offering's huge area can destroy trees and stun her, and Upheaval makes a Scurry retreat difficult.
Pounce dodges or locks down her kit, Shadow Dance makes him unhittable by Acorn Shot, Dark Pact clears all her slows, and her low health is prime Essence Shift bait.
Powershot destroys trees to deny Scurry's passive or interrupt Bushwhack, Acorn Shot lacks true strike so Windrun dodges it easily, and Shackleshot's stun punishes her tree-reliant positioning hard.
His high magic damage and global reveals punish her low health and tree-hiding all game.
Mines placed in trees can kill a Scurrying Hoodwink given her low HP, and Blast Off clears trees to deny the tactic entirely.
His typical item build, Black King Bar, Monkey King Bar, Heaven's Halberd, Scythe of Vyse, directly answers her, and Skeleton Walk escapes her abilities fast.
Spiked Carapace reflects Sharpshooter's damage back for an instant kill, and Vendetta positions him to screen allies and ambush her.
Sharpshooter's break stops Borrowed Time from triggering at all, letting him be killed cleanly.
Sharpshooter's long disable cripples both his offense and defense, and Scurry/Bushwhack kite him easily.
His low-health playstyle makes Sharpshooter's damage extremely dangerous, and the break shuts off Berserker's Blood, his whole power source.
Hex/Earth Spike can't cancel a channeling Sharpshooter -- though his own Finger of Death can still kill her.
He often hides in trees where Bushwhack easily catches him, Acorn Shot hits through fog including a treed target, and Sharpshooter's flying vision while charging scouts the trees for him.
Sharpshooter disables both Blur and Coup de Grace at once, and her crit-reliant playstyle gives Hoodwink time to Scurry to safety near a tree.
Bushwhack stuns and clears him and a nearby illusion near a tree, Sharpshooter breaks Juxtapose and deals big damage, and it ignores illusions entirely so it reliably reveals the real Phantom Lancer.
Sharpshooter can kill him easily if he's shifted fully into agility, early-mid, and Scurry helps catch a Waveform or cover an escape.
Bushwhack's multiple damage instances tear through Refraction fast.

126.note: Fiend's Grip/Nightmare both lock him down hard, and Brain Sap is tough for him to answer in lane.
Rupture fully damages him even mid-ultimate, removing his main escape and disruption tool, and Blood Rite forces a Dissimilate/Astral Step or a silence that's dangerous if paired with Rupture.
Spirit Siphon/Exorcism both damage through Resonant Pulse's shield, and Silence denies his escape or contribution in fights.
A single Jinada usually strips his shield, and Track reveals his position to deny effective rotations.

Doom nullifies his whole impact for 16 seconds of no spells or items, his versatile Devour build can add stun and magic-resist utility, and his high strength and item flexibility resist Void's magic damage.
Fire Remnant outmaneuvers his mobility, Flame Guard resists his mostly-magic kit, and Searing Chains' root denies both Dissimilate and Astral Step.
Earthbind locks him down easily, and the clone swarm bursts through Resonant Pulse's shield fast.
Dream Coil fully denies his escape kit and cripples his damage output in fights, and a late-game Eul's-Blink-Phase Shift Puck becomes very hard to actually kill.
Blink lets her both escape and initiate on him, and she commonly carries the Orchid that shuts down his contribution entirely.
His strong nukes win the lane outright, denying Void Spirit the farm needed to catch up in levels.
Slithereen Crush/Bash of the Deep's brutal physical damage strips his shield fast and stuns him, and Corrosive Haze plus Guardian Sprint closes the gap on a fleeing Void Spirit.
Refraction negates his whole burst, and Meld quickly burns through Resonant Pulse.
Poison Attack makes laning against him miserable, and Corrosive Skin cuts his magic damage hard.
His AoE shreds her spiderling swarm fast, and his mobility outruns even Spin Web -- though an Aghanim's Spinner's Snare turns her webs into a serious hazard, rooting and revealing him.
His high mobility is a constant nuisance, his magic-damage kit punishes Terrorblade's low strength hard, and Terrorblade has no disable to stop the escape.
Dissimilate dodges Homing Missile cleanly, Dissimilate/Astral Step both help dodge or outrange Call Down, and Gyrocopter's total lack of an escape plays right into his mobility.
Dissimilate lets him tank Invoker's combo damage-free by phasing to another realm, and Astral Step's speed makes him hard to land spells on.
He pressures Morphling's farm hard, a full agility-shifted Morphling is easy burst prey, and Dissimilate/Astral Step dodge an Ethereal Blade combo entirely.
He's very hard to keep trapped inside Wukong's Command, and a poorly-positioned Monkey King can be yanked out by Aether Remnant, while landing Jingu Mastery stacks on him is hard.
His early-game damage is all-magic, bypassing Windrun's evasion, and quick reactions dodge Powershot with Dissimilate or Astral Step.

128.note: Mana Break punishes her already-thin mana pool, and Blink dodges Lil' Shredder/Mortimer Kisses entirely.
Global Silence stops a channeling Mortimer Kisses, and Last Word denies a follow-up cast.
Spiked Carapace stops Mortimer Kisses cold.
Ice Blast/Cold Feet/Ice Vortex are all easier to land while she's rooted channeling Mortimer Kisses.
Blade Fury grants immunity to her whole kit while closing distance, and a well-timed Omnislash dodges her spells with no way for her to answer it.
Aphotic Shield blocks the damage and dispels Mortimer Kisses' slow, and Borrowed Time heals through it.
Meat Hook lands easily right after Mortimer Kisses forces her to stand still.
Storm Hammer's stun interrupts a channeling Mortimer Kisses.
Mortimer Kisses quickly destroys his creeps and can force a wasted Hand of God.
Firesnap Cookie can be self-fed or given to an ally trapped in Power Cogs, and a badly placed cog makes aiming Mortimer Kisses on him easy.
Her AoE kit clears his illusion army effectively.
Lil' Shredder shreds Supernova fast, and Mortimer Kisses easily hits him mid-Sun-Ray.
Mortimer Kisses' multiple stacks can't be fully purged by a single Heavenly Grace, and since the damage is magical, Guardian Angel does nothing against it.
Mortimer Kisses can deal massive damage inside Chronosphere, either killing him outright or forcing him out before he finishes anyone trapped.

129.note: Berserker's Call forces his facing direction, and Counter Helix's pure damage bypasses Bulwark entirely.
An active Rage acts as a pseudo-Black King Bar to fully negate his initiation, Feast punishes a high-health strength hero hard, and Infest can burst-heal an ally to save them from the combo.

Blink Strike's backstab bypasses Bulwark and can teleport him out of Arena of Blood, Smoke Screen interrupts his combo especially inside the arena, and Tricks of the Trade dodges his slightly-delayed spells or buys time trapped inside.

Sticky Napalm's turn-rate slow keeps him from facing forward where Bulwark and Spear work, and Firefly's magic damage on top finishes him fast; Flaming Lasso also disables him while allies reposition behind him to dodge Bulwark.

Time Walk escapes or enters Arena of Blood and undoes his burst, Time Lock's magic damage ignores Bulwark, and Chronosphere lets allies reposition behind him while he's frozen, bypassing Bulwark entirely.
Burning Spear's magic damage-over-time is a real lane problem, and Life Break's percent-magic damage both bypasses Bulwark and can jump him in or out of the Arena.
Dragon Slave's reliable magic damage wins the lane, an Eul's-Light Strike Array combo disrupts him for a long stun window, and Laguna Blade, pure with Aghanim's, deals massive damage.
His largely magic kit ignores Bulwark completely, and Ghost Shroud both blocks God's Rebuke and neutralizes his lane threat.
His high base health/regen and Ignite make early trades hard for Mars, Bloodlust helps reposition away from him, and Fireblast, worse with Multicast, interrupts his combos.
Arcane Orb's pure damage ignores Bulwark, Astral Imprisonment saves allies or denies his disruption, and Sanity's Eclipse punishes his low intelligence pool hard.

Nether Blast/Decrepify/Life Drain all bypass Bulwark with magic damage, and Nether Ward punishes the heavy mana cost of Arena of Blood -- he's also one of the few heroes who can contest Mars's early tower pressure.
Swashbuckle and an Aghanim's Shield Crash are both auto-attacks that ignore Bulwark, and Rolling Thunder's spell immunity lets him roll freely in and out of Arena of Blood.
Shadowraze's magic damage bypasses Bulwark, and Requiem of Souls can fear him around to force a vulnerable facing.
Ball Lightning makes him nearly uncatchable solo, and Overload's magic spam wears Mars down without Bulwark helping at all.

Firestorm/Pit of Malice both fit inside Arena of Blood and deal percent magic damage that ignores Bulwark, Dark Rift saves allies trapped in the Arena, Atrophy Aura counters his weak early base damage in lane, and his common Pipe, Mekansm, or Guardian Greaves help the team fight him mid-late.
Decay/Soul Rip/Flesh Golem all deal magic damage that ignores Bulwark, and Decay's strength reduction cuts the health pool he relies on to trade.
His all-magic kit ignores Bulwark, his slows kite Mars's low mobility hard, and Plague Wards can even attack through Arena of Blood.
Nethertoxin breaks Bulwark's damage block outright, and Poison Attack/Viper Strike's slows cripple his already-low mobility.

Snowball protects allies from a Spear-then-Arena combo, or pulls them straight out early-game, Tag Team's damage-over-time plus slow makes Bulwark less effective in lane, though careless Ice Shards can accidentally give Mars terrain to latch Spear onto.
His massive magic damage bypasses Bulwark completely -- Arc Lightning/Lightning Bolt's low cooldowns plus Static Field's percent-health damage shred Mars fast.
Arena of Blood stops him from attacking a Ruptured target, Bulwark tanks a Rupture gank just by facing him, and Spear of Mars/God's Rebuke can push him off a Ruptured ally.
Bulwark mitigates his mostly-physical damage easily, and Omnislash's alternating-direction slashes mean Mars only eats full damage from behind.
Bulwark's percentage mitigation guts Duel's bonus physical damage, and Spear of Mars can buy a Duelled ally time by pushing her away.
Bulwark tanks his attacks by facing him, and can redirect his shots if he targets someone else, and his poor mobility is easy Arena of Blood bait, especially early.

God's Rebuke/Spear of Mars can knock him off Tree Dance if visible, Arena of Blood destroys nearby trees to deny hiding, Bulwark tanks Jingu Mastery attacks, and a well-thrown Spear can end Wukong's Command early while Bulwark absorbs most of the clone damage.

Facing her with Bulwark negates her damage even through a Gust push, and his durability usually buys enough time to land Arena of Blood, which she rarely survives without Gust -- Bulwark's active can even redirect her shots off allies.
Bulwark greatly reduces her physical burst, and God's Rebuke has true strike, ignoring Blur's evasion.

Bulwark blocks much of his attack damage even in Shadow Dance, early Spear/God's Rebuke pressure makes his early-mid game hard, both still hit him through Shadow Dance/Depth Shroud, and he's very vulnerable in Arena of Blood if Pounce is down.
Heavy lane pressure denies her a good game and can force an early, long-cooldown Haunt escape, and late-game Bulwark blocks a lot of her damage while God's Rebuke helps against her Haunt illusions.
Bulwark negates most of his and his illusions' physical damage, and God's Rebuke/Spear of Mars tear through the illusion army fast.

Shukuchi can't escape Arena of Blood and often dies there if spotted through invisibility, God's Rebuke's scaling damage usually finishes him off even pinned to the wall past Time Lapse, and The Swarm/Geminate Attack can't pierce Bulwark.

13.note: Spark Wraith turns Phase Shift against him by guaranteeing the hit (twice, with Tempest Double), and Flux is an instant, unavoidable slow that denies Blink Dagger.
His tankiness survives Puck's burst at any stage, and Doom itself silences him for long enough to usually mean death; the Mute talent locks out items entirely.
Geomagnetic Grip's AoE silence catches him even through Phase Shift, and Magnetize's damage-over-time is inescapable if extended with Stone Remnant.

His whole kit is prime Spell Steal material -- a stolen Waning Rift silences him out of his own survival tool, and Dream Coil is brutal against an elusive hero, while Phase Shift itself grants Rubick a safe Blink Dagger window.
Chronosphere usually means death if it lands, and Time Dilation triples Phase Shift's cooldown, denying his main survival tool.
Three separate damage-over-time sources (plus Aghanim's Liquid Frost) make Blink Dagger hard to keep up, and Ice Path punishes the moment Phase Shift ends.
Shapeshift lets him run Puck down quickly given Puck's low armor.
The Spirit Bear's huge health pool and sustain shrug off his magic damage, and Entangling Claws punishes an Illusory Orb cast.
Void's burst punishes his low health, and Crippling Fear's silence leaves him with nothing to do.
His entire kit answers Puck -- Spiked Carapace punishes a slow Illusory Orb, Mind Flare hurts a squishy intelligence hero, and any Phase Shift used defensively can't also dodge Impale.
A long silence shuts down Puck's entire kit, since he has nothing without his spells.
Refraction blocks his damage-over-time-free burst outright, and Psi Blades' pure damage can't be dodged with Phase Shift.
Venomous Gale plus Noxious Plague ticks constantly through his slow turn rate, complicating a Blink Dagger escape, and Plague Wards can spot him before he initiates.
Poison Attack out-damages what Puck can dodge with Phase Shift, and Corrosive Skin makes early trades bad for him.
Wraithfire Blast is a real threat despite his one-ability kit, denying Blink Dagger for a long time, and Reincarnation lets him fight back even after being burst down.
Dream Coil and Waning Rift deny his own escape combo with Rolling Boulder.
Easy to burst down early with his magic nukes, and Waning Rift/Dream Coil shut down Dissimilate and Astral Step.
Dream Coil and Waning Rift deny Swashbuckle and Rolling Thunder, and Aghanim's Dream Coil stops Rolling Thunder from moving at all.
Phase Shift dodges Nether Blast and Life Drain, Waning Rift's silence neutralizes him in return, and a Witch Blade-boosted combo can solo kill him early.
Waning Rift and Dream Coil both stop Freezing Field regardless of Glimmer Cape.
Illusory Orb and Waning Rift win the lane outright, and Phase Shift dodges his combos in a fight.
Phase Shift dodges Starstorm's delay and outruns Sacred Arrow, and Waning Rift/Dream Coil deny her Leap escape.
Phase Shift dodges her whole burst combo (even Laguna Blade with good timing), and Waning Rift denies her from casting at all.
His slow, health-costly spells rarely land a Blink Dagger denial, and Waning Rift/Dream Coil both shut down Supernova and Sun Ray.
No disables at all to stop Puck, and Illusory Orb plus Blink Dagger closes the distance on a hero that wants range.
AoE magic damage ignores his armor and shreds his illusions fast, Waning Rift denies a low-health Sunder, and Puck commonly carries a finishing Dagon.
Phase Shift dodges Powershot and Shackleshot, Waning Rift denies her whole kit, and Dream Coil punishes any attempt to Windrun away.

135.note: Nethertoxin disables Luminosity, and since she's melee and needs to close in, losing her healing there is brutal; Viper Strike/Poison Attack's slow, unless Celestial Hammer/Solar Guardian are up, makes chasing her down easy too.
Feast punishes her high strength gain hard, especially late -- though Starbreaker's damage can control him in lane.
Spiked Carapace can stop a channeling Solar Guardian, denying her global presence.
Gust shuts down most of her kit, and Frost Arrows plus high attack speed make her hard to escape.
Kinetic Field denies a Celestial Hammer escape, Kinetic Field/Static Storm pin her down right after a Solar Guardian jump, and Glimpse forces her out of a fight the moment she lands.

Time Walk dodges or escapes her ganks and Backtracks her damage, Time Dilation locks her out of casting post-initiation while slowing her hard, Time Lock plus his attack speed traps her in place denying a Celestial Hammer escape, and Chronosphere locks her down right after a Solar Guardian jump -- though a far-off precast Solar Guardian can discourage the Chronosphere in the first place.

Starbreaker deals huge damage and clears his creep waves, Celestial Hammer's damage-over-time can force an early Hand of God, and Solar Guardian counters his pushing while an Aghanim's version even grants evasion against Penitence.

Starbreaker/Celestial Hammer's AoE clears treants fast, she can teleport to answer a split push and rejoin with Solar Guardian, and Starbreaker's tree-clearing-then-stun denies a Sprout-and-teleport escape entirely.
Solar Guardian saves a Duelled ally and interrupts the initiation.
Solar Guardian saves allies caught inside Arena of Blood.

Starbreaker/Celestial Hammer/Solar Guardian all clear illusion waves fast, an Aghanim's Shard Starbreaker dispels Ensnare to fight through Song of the Siren with Black King Bar, and Solar Guardian counters her push while granting evasion against her mostly-physical damage.
Solar Guardian saves an ally he's charged and focused.
She has no disable or silence for Dawnbreaker's kit, Solar Guardian denies Desolate's bonus by standing next to an ally, and Luminosity outheals Dispersion's reflected damage.

136.note: Unleash's attack speed feeds heavy Counter Helix procs even through a Dispose stun, an Aghanim's Counter Helix cuts her damage further as she attacks, and Berserker's Call or an active Blade Mail/Mjollnir turns Unleash's speed and damage back on her -- Rebound also tends to bring her right into his most effective range.
A well-timed Counterspell reflects and blocks a Dispose throw.

Rupture ruins Rebound, her only mobility tool, and its current-health-based damage punishes her naturally high HP hard; without Black King Bar, Blood Rite also shuts off her whole kit since her only dispel is a late talent -- his Aghanim's Bloodrage even deals pure damage and lifesteal off her high max health.

Bramble Maze likely catches her mid-jump, Shadow Realm denies her whole physical and unit-target kit, worse with Aghanim's letting Willow hit back, Bedlam-plus-Eul's lets Willow manfight a Rebound initiation, and Terrorize-Cursed Crown can waste nearly half her ultimate.
Spirit Siphon exploits her high HP for good sustained damage, Silence covers a broken link if she Rebounds away, and her poor armor makes her easy Exorcism prey.
Rage grants immunity to her whole kit, and Feast punishes her naturally high strength and HP hard.
Howl cuts a chunk of her attack damage and hits her low armor extra hard, and Shapeshift ignores Rebound/Unleash's slows entirely.
Death Pulse/Ghost Shroud both counter her physical damage well, and Heartstopper Aura/Reaper's Scythe punish a tanky strength hero hard.
Fortune's End dispels Sidekick's bonus damage and lifesteal, Fate's Edict's disarm shuts off Unleash, useful against her or a Sidekicked ally, and False Promise saves a target she's focusing.
Lucky Shot's disarm nullifies Unleash if it procs, and Swashbuckle's shorter cooldown lets him outmaneuver Rebound easily.

His counter-initiation kit reduces her effectiveness, Fatal Bonds cancels a Blink Dagger jump, Chaotic Offering-Upheaval's ministun-plus-slow punishes her jump timing and makes Rebound harder to land, and an Aghanim's-Refresher Golem build overwhelms her especially as a support.

Her natural Linken's Sphere blocks Dispose entirely, Shukuchi escapes Rebound's slow, and The Swarm forces an awkward choice between losing armor stacks to a beetle or wasting Unleash attacks killing it.

Untouchable doesn't stop Unleash's massive attack-speed buff, her low health folds fast to Marci's burst, and Rebounding onto an enchanted creep, many with short range, closes the gap while negating Impetus's range bonus.
Rebound jumps in or out of Arena of Blood freely, and Dispose can pull an ally out of it too.
Sprout can't stop a Rebound, and his treants make convenient Rebound and Dispose targets.
Unleash alone can destroy Supernova at any stage, and his squishy, low-armor frame is easy Rebound/Sidekick prey in lane.
Her level-6 power spike crushes his low health pool and forces him to play far back, and even pre-6, Dispose-Sidekick can take half his health if he's in range.

137.note: Fate's Edict negates his mostly-magic burst and can render him useless if he's focusing that target, Fortune's End interrupts a Trample or Onslaught channel, and False Promise, paired with Fortune's End, delays or fully denies his lethal combos.

Power Cogs pins him down and its knockback can even intercept an Onslaught charge, Battery Assault denies a lone Primal Beast from winding up Onslaught or attacking at all, and Rocket Flare/an Aghanim's Shard Jetpack scout him out before his ambush lands.

Rupture is deadly since his kit needs movement to deal damage, and its current-health-scaling damage is devastating against his naturally high strength and HP -- though he can turn a Blade Mail back on Bloodseeker unless Bloodseeker has Black King Bar.

Glimpse denies an Onslaught initiation for most of the game, Static Storm-plus-Kinetic Field locks him out of casting for a long stretch, and overall he's forced into an early Black King Bar he'd rather not need yet -- though he becomes a real threat to Disruptor once he has it.
Soulbind denies Onslaught or his kit's effectiveness for a long window, and his slow attack speed, worsened by his own Trample, makes Phantom's Embrace very hard to shake off.

Malefice locks him down for a long time even at his early-game strongest, Midnight Pulse scales huge off his max health, and since he's fully mobility-dependent, Black Hole denies him from threatening anyone at all.
Pit of Malice is excellent at keeping him out of a fight and stopping Trample entirely, and an Aghanim's Fiend's Gate can globally stop Trample temporarily or force a Black King Bar charge.

Trample's disarm means he can't destroy Supernova no matter how close he is, an Aghanim's version even lets him save an ally the same way, Sun Ray can deal thousands of damage to his scaling health pool if it survives, Icarus Dive is a great post-Onslaught escape, and Phoenix's naturally huge health resists his mostly-magic damage.
God's Strength punishes his low natural armor hard if caught before Uproar, and Storm Hammer reliably escapes him or saves his team.
His heavy lane disable chain makes it very hard for Primal Beast to stick a Trample target.

Berserker's Call is just a plain stun for him since Trample already denies his attacks and his attack speed is low, Battle Hunger/Counter Helix/Blade Mail barely matter given his much bigger health pool, Culling Blade's threshold is hard to reach given his health advantage, and Trample-Uproar-Onslaught does huge damage in lane even against a Vanguard Axe.

Onslaught's mobility makes him hard to pin with Cold Feet/Ice Blast, his huge health pool blunts Ice Blast's value, Chilling Touch's slow isn't enough to beat him back and just feeds Uproar stacks, and his level-20 dispel talent clears Cold Feet the moment Uproar triggers.

Trample cuts down the trees she hides in, giving him an edge catching her, Insatiable Hunger can't outheal his onslaught of disables, Silken Bola's slow isn't enough to stop Trample's damage advantage, and Onslaught/Trample destroy Spawn Spiderlings easily.

Dispersion's percentage reduction barely matters against Trample's many small hits, Desolate never threatens his big health pool since Uproar out-damages it, Onslaught chases her through trees and terrain right alongside Spectral Dagger, his level-15 talent dispels Spectral Dagger's slow outright, and his early aggression generally ruins her lane -- an Aghanim's Scepter even breaks both her passives.

Uproar tanks a chunk of Omnislash and Onslaught can even charge him away as it ends, Blade Fury never outdamages an active Uproar, he commonly buys Ethereal Blade/Heart of Tarrasque which are strong against Juggernaut, and Onslaught is one of the few ultimates that can stop a Blade Fury teleport-away.

His total lack of escape and early squishiness make him one of Sniper's worst matchups, potshots and Shrapnel just feed Uproar stacks making him tankier, and Onslaught closes the gap on his own terms while Trample punishes Sniper's thin health pool.
Onslaught's mobility makes all of Razor's abilities ineffective against him, especially in lane.

Dark Pact/Shadow Dance/Depth Shroud all do nothing against Onslaught/Trample's ground AoE, his huge hitbox makes a blocking Pounce hard to escape and Pounce doesn't fully stop offensive Trampling, his big health pool resists Essence Shift while feeding Uproar stacks fast, and an Aghanim's Scepter even breaks Essence Shift's on-attack proc.

Pierce the Veil doesn't stop his full kit and he's one of the few heroes who can disable her mid-ultimate even through a common Black King Bar, likely fatal to her if he has an active Blade Mail, and an Aghanim's Scepter can even disable Gunslinger.

His huge health pool resists Eclipse/Lucent Beam nukes, his speed advantage makes escaping him hard for her especially in lane, his ultimate pierces debuff immunity so her Black King Bar barely helps, and he commonly carries a Blade Mail that's a big problem for her single-target burst.

Magnus isn't tanky and struggles against the burst Primal Beast excels at early-mid, he can even out-damage and feed Uproar off Empower, and dragging him mid-Trample with Skewer counts as movement, triggering a rapid, potentially lethal slam sequence.
Sprout gets destroyed by Trample and Onslaught easily.

His lack of a stun and low early-mid health make him vulnerable to Primal Beast's combos, Reflection can be dispelled with a level-15 talent, and Sunder is the only real threat back -- though he may die before ever using it.

Her known weakness to magic burst plays right into his kit, especially hunting her down while she farms alone, he commonly carries Ethereal Blade/Vanguard/Shiva's which all answer Coup de Grace and Phantom Strike well, and once Blur becomes relevant late she can still get overwhelmed by Trample/Onslaught -- his ultimate pierces spell immunity too, worse with the level-25 talent, and his level-15 talent dispels Stifling Dagger and its modifiers.

He has multiple ways to quickly cancel a channeling Life Drain, Pugna's low strength gain and thin support gold make him vulnerable to his magic onslaught, and though Decrepify ironically boosts Trample's damage on the target, it can also slow Primal Beast enough to deny further hits.

138.note: Borrowed Time mitigates most of Pierce the Veil's damage, and since she has no way to control Gunslinger's autocast, he can regen freely off her.
She lacks the speed to easily dodge Cold Feet, which can control her mid-Pierce the Veil, and his Chilling Touch outranges her to poke safely.
Counterspell's magic resistance makes him hard to burst, Blink escapes since she has no hard disable, and Mana Break-Mana Void punishes her big intelligence pool and lack of an escape.

Most of his kit still hits her through Pierce the Veil except the physical Battle Hunger, and his bigger health pool plus Berserker's Call/Blade Mail turns her own attack speed against her, while Counter Helix punishes her stacked attack speed hard.

Nightmare/Fiend's Grip can waste a Pierce the Veil cast, Brain Sap trades well against her low early health, and Brain Sap/Fiend's Grip both damage and disable her even through Pierce the Veil and Black King Bar; Enfeeble also cuts the attack damage and cast range she depends on.

Incapacitating Bite raises her miss chance until she buys true-strike items, Spawn Spiderlings' magic damage still hits her under Pierce the Veil, a common Revenant's Brooch attacks through it too, Spin Web's speed makes The Calling hard to land, and an Aghanim's Spinner's Snare roots and damages her if she steps on an invisible web line.
Terrorize/Bedlam/Cursed Crown all still damage her through Pierce the Veil, and Shadow Realm makes her immune to Muerta's attacks for its duration even through Black King Bar.

Solar Guardian helps a team caught in The Calling, with Aghanim's granting evasion against her attacks too, Solar Guardian/Starbreaker can disable her even through Pierce the Veil and Black King Bar though Starbreaker's own damage is physical, Celestial Hammer/Solar Guardian's magic damage fights back through Pierce the Veil, a common Revenant's Brooch attacks through it too, and her natural Black King Bar, or an Aghanim's Shard debuff-immune Starbreaker, protects against Muerta's kit.
Aftershock chain-stuns plus Fissure minimize Pierce the Veil's effective uptime.

His whole kit is damage-over-time, so it still hits her through Pierce the Veil, Dual Breath/Liquid Fire harass in lane, Ice Path stuns her mid-ultimate for allies to escape or counter-initiate, and an Aghanim's Macropyre's pure damage pierces both Pierce the Veil and Black King Bar -- though The Calling's silence is dangerous for his low mobility, and Liquid Fire/Frost can't target her under Pierce the Veil unless he's near her target or has Revenant's Brooch.

Blade Fury grants spell immunity and deals magic damage, both hard counters to her -- though it's his only source of magic damage, meaning Nullifier can't dispel Pierce the Veil's undispellable ethereal state, forcing a Revenant's Brooch instead.

Rage grants immunity to Pierce the Veil and blocks Dead Shot's fear and damage, Infest dodges her shots and Dead Shot while surprising her, an Aghanim's Infest can even disarm her through Black King Bar, but his only real damage through Pierce the Veil is Infest, forcing a Revenant's Brooch.

Lucent Beam harasses her in lane, her speed makes Dead Shot/The Calling hard to land, Pierce the Veil actually amplifies Lucent Beam/Eclipse's magic damage against herself, an Aghanim's Eclipse counter-initiates until she affords Black King Bar, an Aghanim's Shard Moon Glaives cuts her damage though it can't hit her physically under Pierce the Veil, and her natural Black King Bar/Revenant's Brooch both answer her kit directly.

His burst, ganking, and disables threaten her at every stage, Mind Flare punishes her high intelligence and low health, Spiked Carapace/Vendetta both escape or initiate well against her low mobility, and Spiked Carapace especially punishes stray Gunslinger shots -- though her natural Black King Bar shuts Nyx down hard if activated first, since Spiked Carapace can't pierce debuff immunity.

Astral Imprisonment wastes over half of Pierce the Veil or protects an ally from Dead Shot's fear while draining her max mana, and Sanity's Eclipse punishes a low mana pool hard, discouraging further casting via its mana-allergy healing OD.

His high health and Flesh Heap damage block make him hard to burst, his magic damage from Meat Hook/Dismember bursts her fast even through Pierce the Veil and Black King Bar, and her lack of escape and mobility makes her easy hook bait -- an Aghanim's Shard even protects an ally from Gunslinger.

Shackles/Hex both can land on her mid-Pierce-the-Veil to waste it until Black King Bar, and Ether Shock/Shackles deal high damage through it -- though Mass Serpent Ward can't hurt her while it's active.

Glaives of Wisdom cuts her damage output, and a common Revenant's Brooch attacks through Pierce the Veil, Last Word/Global Silence deny her spells, and Arcane Curse punishes her for casting Dead Shot.

Dispersion both blunts her attacks and reflects real damage back at her fragile health, an Aghanim's Shadow Step/Haunt let Spectre engage or escape a Pierce the Veil, and a common Radiance lets her fight back through it -- she also generally out-carries Muerta into the late game.

His huge magic damage makes activating Pierce the Veil risky without Black King Bar, The Calling's attack-speed reduction is nearly pointless against a non-attack-reliant hero, and Heavenly Jump disengages if she closes in.
Dead Shot breaks Sprout, Gunslinger clears treants fast, and The Calling cuts their potential damage hard.
Ghost Shroud doesn't stop her from attacking through Pierce the Veil and makes him even more vulnerable, and Heartstopper Aura barely matters given how fast she bursts him with her small health pool.

His low health and armor-from-Essence-Shift reliance make him easy Pierce the Veil prey, his physical attacks and Essence Shift can't touch her during it, and Dead Shot/The Calling still hit him hidden in Shadow Dance.
Take Aim gets wasted against Pierce the Veil or a well-aimed Dead Shot, Dead Shot can displace him into her team's kill range, and his pure right-click reliance is useless against Pierce the Veil.

Pierce the Veil ignores Warcry entirely, God's Strength can simply be ignored the same way, and even his Aghanim's can't dispel her undispellable ethereal form -- though his natural Black King Bar answers her whole kit.
Dead Shot passes through his whole illusion army, letting her isolate the real one easily -- though his mobility is still a real threat to her limited movement.

His high-armor-low-health build is extremely vulnerable to Pierce the Veil, Gunslinger plus a common Mjollnir shreds his illusions fast, Reflection/Metamorphosis can't touch her during Pierce the Veil, and The Calling's silence denies a saving Sunder while her natural Black King Bar blocks it outright.
Reactive Armor's bonus doesn't help against Pierce the Veil despite her high attack speed, and Dead Shot destroys the trees Timber Chain needs to escape.

His low health and armor-reliance make him very susceptible to Pierce the Veil, Battle Trance can simply be ignored by activating it, and The Calling resets an allied Battle Trance's attack-speed buff back to normal.

14.note: Borrowed Time or Aphotic Shield strip Dismember's stun and silence outright, and his own lack of mobility without Blink Dagger makes him easy prey for Curse of Avernus.
A quick Blink after getting hooked can save him, Counterspell resists the magic damage Pudge relies on, and Mana Break can drain the mana Meat Hook/Dismember need.
His low armor and poor agility gain make him take heavy damage from Viscous Nasal Goo/Quill Spray, and Bristleback's tankiness plus magic resistance makes him a poor hook target.
Track denies him the fog-of-war hooks he relies on, and Shuriken Toss cancels Dismember from range.
One of the worst heroes to hook -- Phantasm illusions deal full damage and are tanky, and Reality Rift's armor shred plus his own low mobility makes it worse.
Doom denies Rot toggling and can set up a lethal drain, and his high health/strength/Infernal Blade punish Pudge's big health pool hard.
Press the Attack dispels Dismember and its regen offsets Rot, and Duel during Rot can turn the health drain against Pudge.
Feast scales off Pudge's huge health pool, Rage's spell immunity blanks Rot entirely, and Open Wounds (with Aghanim's) punishes his health pool hard.
A quick Leap after getting hooked can save her, Moonlight Shadow's invisibility makes her hard to hook, and Sacred Arrow cancels Dismember from range.
Heartstopper Aura's percent-health drain punishes his big pool (worse combined with Rot self-damage), and Reaper's Scythe often finishes him below 40% health regardless of Flesh Heap stacks.
Void's mini-stun plus Crippling Fear's silence deny Dismember or Rot toggling outright, and his tankiness/magic resistance make him a poor hook target.
Impale or Spiked Carapace can interrupt Dismember, even if used on Nyx Assassin himself.
Sanity's Eclipse scales up the less mana the target has, making Pudge an ideal target, and Astral Imprisonment can save allies from Meat Hook or Dismember.
Spell Stealing Meat Hook lets Rubick fish out and save Pudge's targets.
Corrosive Haze reveals his position, denying fog-of-war hooks, and Slithereen Crush interrupts Dismember while Guardian Sprint dodges Meat Hook.
Dark Pact dispels a well-timed Dismember, Pounce escapes Rot once Dismember ends, and Shadow Dance's mobility (extendable to allies via Aghanim's Shard) makes him hard to hook or Dismember.
Kraken Shell dispels Dismember past a damage threshold, and his tankiness plus magic-resist itemization make him a poor hook target.
Whirling Death's percent-strength reduction is brutal against Pudge's Flesh-Heap-fueled strength, and his mobility/tankiness make him a bad hook target.
Shukuchi's invisibility and mobility make him hard to hook, Swarm beetles are annoying to clear and can scout Pudge, and Aghanim's Time Lapse can even undo an in-progress Dismember.
Meat Hook cancels Freezing Field even through Glimmer Cape, and her low mobility/fragility makes her easy gank bait.
Meat Hook pulls her into melee to shut off Marksmanship, and Dismember denies her Gust or Shadow Blade escape.
A Phantom Strike jump onto Pudge backfires badly into Meat Hook/Dismember, both of which pierce Black King Bar, and his own armor stacking plus Flesh Heap blunts her damage back.
His low health/strength makes him vulnerable to Rot and Meat Hook drags him out of his comfort range, while Flesh Heap stacks blunt Assassinate and block most of Shrapnel.
Dismember denies a Haunt escape and can even hook her out of a Spectral Dagger retreat, his strength and Dismember healing tank Dispersion reflect, and his ganks disrupt her slow early game.
Meat Hook pulls him out of hiding in the trees for a Dismember/Rot follow-up, and Flesh Heap makes him hard to burst since Tinker rarely builds survivability.
His low health folds fast once hooked into the fight, and Flesh Heap's strength makes him hard for Zeus to burst down in return.

15.note: Blink breaks Static Link outright, and Counterspell reflects it back onto Razor.
Razor has no way to deal with the Phantasm illusion army.
Stampede breaks Static Link and outruns both Eye of the Storm and Plasma Field's slow.
Boulder Smash and (Aghanim's) Geomagnetic Grip's long-range repositioning make it hard to keep anyone in Static Link/Eye of the Storm range.
Life Break plus Burning Spear can kill Razor before Static Link steals enough damage to turn the fight, though Berserker's Blood makes stealing risky either way.
Waveform breaks Static Link instantly, or he can just Morph into Razor and turn the drained damage (or his own) back on him.
He rarely builds damage items so Static Link has little to steal, Ghost Shroud denies him attacking with the stolen damage, and Reaper's Scythe punishes his vulnerability to magic.
Most of his damage comes from Arcane Orb so stealing it does little, Astral Imprisonment denies the stolen damage or an Eye of the Storm chase, and Sanity's Eclipse punishes his low mana hard.
Blink instantly breaks Static Link, and she doesn't fully rely on physical damage to keep fighting after it lands.
Static Link is easy Spell Steal fodder, letting Rubick recover his own drained damage or steal Razor's.
Pounce breaks Static Link, Essence Shift lets him actually win a straight fight, and Shadow Dance denies Razor's attacks entirely.
His superior range makes it hard to get close for Static Link or Eye of the Storm, and Headshot's knockback slows Razor regardless of Storm Surge.
Poison Attack and Viper Strike slow him hard and cut his attack speed, blunting Static Link's value.
Shukuchi breaks Static Link easily, and Time Lapse can undo both Plasma Field and Eye of the Storm damage.
Eye of the Storm melts his armor, and Static Link drains the bonus damage from Warpath entirely.
Static Link drains the Enchant Totem bonus until he breaks it with Aghanim's or Force Staff, and Eye of the Storm/Plasma Field deny Blink Dagger (re-)initiations.
Static Link can't be dispelled by Rage or Infest so Razor tracks him through an escape, Storm Surge keeps pace, and Eye of the Storm pierces Rage's spell immunity.
Static Link steals the Jingu Mastery bonus and weakens Boundless Strike/Wukong's Command, and it grants vision on him through Tree Dance or Mischief while Plasma Field denies the mobility outright.
Static Link cuts Coup de Grace's damage, Eye of the Storm can't be evaded by Blur, and both pierce the spell immunity she leans on from Black King Bar.
Plasma Field/Eye of the Storm clear illusions fast, Static Link marks the real one since neither Doppelganger nor Manta dispel it, and Storm Surge outruns Phantom Rush.
Nether Strike can't remove Static Link, and Eye of the Storm melts his armor.

Plasma Field/Eye of the Storm clear his illusions, Static Link cripples his damage even in Metamorphosis and can't be dispelled by Manta or blocked by Black King Bar, and Storm Surge (with Aghanim's) outruns and punishes him -- though Razor's own lack of disables means he needs Black King Bar or Linken's to survive a Sunder.
Static Link is brutal against an attack-speed-reliant hero, even worse if he's used Battle Trance since there's no way to break the link.
Plasma Field spots him sneaking into Roshan's pit, Static Link can't be dispelled by Enrage, Storm Surge usually outruns him, and Eye of the Storm melts his armor.
Static Link cuts Focus Fire's damage, and Eye of the Storm's strikes can't miss even through Windrun.

16.note: Boulder Smash can knock him out of Sand Storm or off a target mid-Epicenter, and Rolling Boulder/Geomagnetic Grip interrupt the whole combo.
None of his spells threaten Supernova, and Phoenix's damage-over-time abilities frequently deny his Blink Dagger.
Burrowstrike is a very easy, very dangerous Spell Steal.
Arcane Curse and Last Word both punish a spammy caster, Intelligence Steal shrinks his mana pool further, and Global Silence can even interrupt an Epicenter channel.
Ravage's AoE cancels Epicenter from long range, though a Black King Bar into Blink Dagger sequence can work around it.

He usually stays too far back to Blink onto easily, and Thundergod's Wrath (plus the rest of his kit) frequently denies Blink Dagger, while Lightning Bolt reveals him in Sand Storm and interrupts Epicenter.
Caustic Finale kills her spiderlings easily, and Blink Dagger plus Burrowstrike catches a split-pushing Broodmother.
Burrowstrike escapes Eclipse or closes the gap to finish her, Sand Storm invisibility dodges her burst and forces a Dust purchase, and Caustic Finale punishes her short attack range hard in lane.
Burrowstrike can stun several clones at once, and Epicenter/Sand Storm's AoE damages all clones evenly, making it hard for Meepo to pick which to save.
Caustic Finale clears his treants easily, and Burrowstrike denies a Teleportation cast inside Sprout.

Her Blur does nothing against his heavy magic damage, Burrowstrike often catches her before Black King Bar is up, and Sand Storm dodges Stifling Dagger while his mobility makes him hard for her to kill back.
Burrowstrike and Sand Storm give him enough survivability that Slark struggles to kill him, and Shadow Dance doesn't help against pure AoE damage.
Sand Storm strips Refraction fast, leaving her very exposed to Epicenter's damage.

17.note: Mana Break drains the mana he needs to escape, Blink catches him out of a Ball Lightning, Mana Void punishes his low remaining mana hard, and Counterspell blunts his damage (or reflects it).
Doom locks him out of every ability and item, making him useless for the duration.
Flame Guard tanks a big chunk of his magic damage, Searing Chains roots him so Ball Lightning can't save him, and Fire Remnant burst can kill him early.
Her longer-range kit wins the lane outright and forces him to just survive rather than farm.
The long night-time Crippling Fear leaves him stuck relying on items, and Dark Ascension lets Night Stalker initiate on him across terrain he'd otherwise be safe behind.
Vendetta drains his big mana pool and deals heavy damage, cutting into his escape options.
Her longer-range kit wins the lane and denies his farm, and a well-timed Black King Bar lets her avoid his Electric Vortex burst later.
Smoke Screen shuts down his spellcasting entirely inside the radius, denying Overload procs.
Intelligence Steal cuts into his damage, and Last Word/Global Silence make him an easy target.
Stasis Trap roots him and Blast Off silences him for long enough to deny a Ball Lightning escape entirely.

His stun/damage combo (Snowball into Walrus Punch, worse with Silver Edge, plus Ice Shards and Tag Team) can burst him down before he reacts -- though Ball Lightning before the Snowball lands can dodge it.
Arcane Orb wins a straight fight outright, and Astral Imprisonment lets him gank Storm safely first.
Cold Feet alone can't stop him, and his fragility/no magic resistance makes him easy prey for Storm's combo.
Ball Lightning hunts him down since he has no real escape, and none of his tools threaten a hero who can just dodge them with it.
He's invulnerable during Ball Lightning, making Rupture useless against him.
His ranged attacks win the lane outright and punish any approach with Static Remnant, and a Falcon Blade gives him enough health to shrug off Earth Spirit's damage.
All-magic damage bypasses Bulwark, and Ball Lightning escapes Arena of Blood while dodging Spear of Mars easily.
Ball Lightning clears trees to deny Tree Dance, and easily dodges Wukong's Command or Boundless Strike.
Ball Lightning shreds his illusions fast, dodges Spirit Lance, and makes him nearly impossible to catch even with Phantom Rush.
Ball Lightning breaks Static Link outright, and Razor has no way to catch him.
He closes the gap on a hero with no real escape, and can dodge Assassinate with well-timed Ball Lightning.

With no stun and total reliance on right-clicks and spell immunity, he has no answer to Black Hole unless he initiates first with Abyssal Blade, and Black Hole/Midnight Pulse both pierce Rage.
Rage/Infest dodge Eclipse, but her physical damage from Moon Glaives/Lunar Blessing is enough regardless, and Manta Style dispels Ghoul Frenzy/Open Wounds while denying his illusion matchup.
Enfeeble weakens Feast and forces an early Rage or a dispel item, and Fiend's Grip pierces spell immunity to lock him down mid-Rage.
Ice Blast blocks both his lifesteal and Infest's healing mid-fight.
Chaos Strike's burst passive lets him survive and even punish Lifestealer's attacks, worse at level 20, and his single-target nature struggles against the Phantasm illusion army.
Burning Barrage/Searing Arrows deal pure physical damage that overrides Rage entirely, and his lack of disables lets Clinkz kite him freely in Skeleton Walk.

His illusions and ranged Metamorphosis attacks burst Lifestealer down fast, his low strength makes him a weak Feast target, and his own reliable self-heal makes him great Sunder bait -- though Aghanim's Infest can disarm and neutralize Terrorblade back.
His illusion swarm forces Lifestealer to either waste abilities early or overitemize, and a core Diffusal Blade shuts down his small mana pool.
Shadow Dance lets Slark attack freely and steal stats with Essence Shift, Pounce escapes easily, and a common Silver Edge breaks Feast outright.
His lack of mobility and disables makes him easy Fervor bait, ranged Whirling Axes/Berserker's Rage kite or force an early Rage, and Battle Trance lets Troll survive Feast and turn the fight.
Fury Swipes pierces spell immunity to punish a Rage duel, and Enrage lets Ursa tank through and delay Feast.
The Swarm can lower his armor even through Rage, he has no disable for Shukuchi, and Time Lapse undoes his slow damage buildup, or with Aghanim's saves an ally outright.
Her poor mobility and low health make her easy Rage-chase prey, and a common Abyssal Blade, or Aghanim's Infest, cancels Freezing Field even through spell immunity.
Rage delays Decay's strength steal and lets him tear down Tombstone uninterrupted, and Feast's percentage lifesteal offsets the drain -- none of Undying's kit pierces spell immunity.
Rage protects him from her entire kit.
Rage protects him from Invoker's whole kit except Sun Strike.
None of his active abilities pierce spell immunity, Hoof Stomp's wind-up is easy to dodge with Rage, and Feast offsets Retaliate's return damage while his big health pool is ideal to feast on.
Rage makes him immune to the whole kit including Reactive Tazer's disarm, and it's safe to trigger Proximity Mines under it.
Rage grants total immunity to his damage and debuffs, and infesting a mobile ally guarantees a kill if Tinker gets caught.
Rage dispels and blocks his magical debuffs, and his big health pool is a great Feast target.
Rage lets him freely attack and hunt Nyx down since Spiked Carapace can't stop spell-immune damage, and Aghanim's Open Wounds/Infest give him even more ways to punish Nyx.
Rage blocks everything except Global Silence, which still lands through spell immunity, and Open Wounds punishes his lack of an escape.
Feast makes him impossible to Cull and deals huge damage to Axe's high health -- though Berserker's Call/Counter Helix still pierce Rage if Axe brings allies.

Flame Guard blocks all his ability damage outright.
X Marks the Spot denies a Surge-boosted escape.
His whole kit is easy Spell Steal fodder.
Fortune's End dispels Ion Shell/Surge including off creeps he uses to farm and zone, making any gank attempt on him land easily, and Fate's Edict blocks his magic damage outright.
Take Aim's range makes him hard to punish with any of Dark Seer's spells, though a Wall of Replica illusion of Sniper is dangerous to deal with.
Ion Shell is brutal against her spiderling swarm and makes laning miserable for her.

Vacuum/Ion Shell clear a creep wave fast, Surge's haste ignores Penitence's slow for an easy escape, and the full Vacuum-Wall of Replica-Normal Punch combo can kill Chen before he saves anyone with Hand of God.
Ion Shell burns through Refraction fast, and Surge ignores Psionic Trap's slow entirely.
Ion Shell destroys Living Armor stacks quickly.
Putting Ion Shell on a clone punishes the whole swarm via Divided We Stand, and Vacuum isolates a single Meepo for the team to burst.

Vacuum/Ion Shell clear a wave of his illusions fast, his reliance on Ultimate Orb items like Manta/Skadi makes a Wall of Replica illusion of him dangerously strong, and Vacuum grouping enables an easy kill before he Sunders.
His low health and range make him easy Ion Shell bait on a creep, and since Surge ignores slows he can't be chased or escaped from.

56.note: Thirst reveals him if he tries to escape low-health with Skeleton Walk and lets Bloodseeker match his speed, and Rupture ignores Skeleton Walk's mobility entirely.
Track reveals him through Skeleton Walk for a big gold bounty, and Jinada with physical items kills him fast given his low health.
Scorched Earth damages him even through Skeleton Walk, and Doom shuts off his whole spellcasting kit.
Untouchable's attack-speed slow denies his lane harassment, and Nature's Attendants sustains through it.
Hex/Earth Spike hold him in place with no chance to use Black King Bar or Skeleton Walk, and Finger of Death kills him fast given his low health.

Morph lets him use Burning Barrage/Searing Arrows right back, Waveform chases him down easily, and his low health is vulnerable to Morphling's magic nukes, especially an Ethereal Blade-Adaptive Strike combo.
Corrosive Haze reveals him for an easy kill, Guardian Sprint catches up to Skeleton Walk, and Slithereen Crush's stun and slow holds him in place.
Haunt instantly finds him anywhere, Spectral Dagger catches him through Skeleton Walk, Desolate still hits him invisible, and Dispersion tanks and reflects his damage.

Charge of Darkness tracks him through Skeleton Walk's invisibility from anywhere on the map, and a Dust of Appearance guarantees a reveal once he's stunned, while his high strength and armor let him tank the fight back.
Nature's Guise lets him set up ganks on a roaming Clinkz from invisibility, Living Armor sustains through the harass, and Overgrowth disarms or holds him even through Black King Bar.
Cold Embrace heals and protects an ally from him while wasting his mana if Searing Arrows is on autocast, and Winter's Curse turns his damage against his own team.
Lightning Bolt reveals him, and his low health is vulnerable to Zeus's magic nukes.

Counterspell doesn't protect against his physical damage, and though a rushed Orchid denies Blink, Manta dispels it easily -- his real edge is contesting map control and split-pushing before Anti-Mage comes online.
Flame Guard offers no protection from his physical damage, and his low armor and health die fast if a teammate can hold him down.

Berserker's Blood does nothing against his physical burst, and he commonly buys the items that answer Huskar's kit -- Black King Bar or Monkey King Bar for Heaven's Halberd, or a disable like Scythe of Vyse/Bloodthorn to deny Inner Fire.
His invisibility lets him hunt a solo Nature's Prophet down, though a Quelling Blade may be needed to cut through Sprout and an Orchid to finish the kill before a teleport.
He has no passives at all, making Nethertoxin nearly useless, and Corrosive Skin does nothing against his physical damage.

57.note: Storm's Dispel Magic instantly strips Heavenly Grace/Guardian Angel from anyone in range.
Doom shuts down his entire kit, and devouring a Satyr Banisher gives him a Purge to strip Heavenly Grace/Guardian Angel too.
Impetus deals pure damage that fully ignores Guardian Angel, and Enchanting a Satyr Banisher gives her the same Purge trick to strip his buffs.
Tornado dispels his buffs off multiple targets, EMP drains his small mana pool, and his disable chain outlasts a timed-out Guardian Angel.
His AoE magic damage makes it hard to save more than one ally at once, and Aghanim's Macropyre deals pure damage-over-time that pierces both Repel and Guardian Angel.
Being mostly magical, Guardian Angel barely helps against her, she commonly dispels it with Eul's, and an ally-killing Laguna Blade, worse with the pure-damage talent, ignores it outright.
Guardian Angel doesn't stop Eclipse's magic damage, only Moon Glaives, and her burst often outpaces his saves.
Song of the Siren times out Guardian Angel for a free counter-initiate, and a nuker-build Naga with Radiance, Ethereal Blade, Dagon, and Veil bypasses it with magic damage entirely.
Fortune's End's AoE dispel strips Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel outright.
Arcane Orb's pure damage bypasses Guardian Angel, and Astral Imprisonment's mana steal devastates his small pool.
His whole kit is valuable Spell Steal fodder with no throwaway spell to bait onto.
Global Silence takes him fully out of the fight, and Glaives of Wisdom's pure damage ignores both his armor and Guardian Angel.
An Aghanim's Storm Hammer's wide radius dispels Guardian Angel despite Sven's mostly physical kit.
His healing keeps allies above the Culling Blade threshold, Heavenly Grace dispels Battle Hunger, and Purification punishes Axe for getting close enough to Counter Helix.
Purification kills Phantasm illusions fast, Heavenly Grace dispels Chaos Bolt's stun and Reality Rift's armor reduction, and Guardian Angel directly answers his all-physical burst.
Guardian Angel blocks Exorcism's damage outright, and Heavenly Grace dispels Silence off allies.
Guardian Angel negates all physical damage taken inside Chronosphere, and Purification-Heavenly Grace can save an ally caught by a Time Walk.
Guardian Angel blocks Omnislash/Swiftslash entirely.
Both Guardian Angel and Purification are near-perfect Duel counters.

Purification/Hammer of Purity punish a Phantom Strike jump, Heavenly Grace dispels her slows and disable items, and since she's 100% physical and rarely buys magic items, Guardian Angel renders her useless.
Guardian Angel fully counters Winter's Curse if cast in time.

Her spiderling swarm overwhelms Enchant's single-target control and her lack of waveclear, though Untouchable's attack-speed slow makes her hard to burst down even through spell immunity.
Frostbite deals heavy damage and roots her creeps for a long time, hurting her ganking.
Blade Fury dispels Enchant's slow and bursts her down in lane, Omnislash/Swiftslash ignore Untouchable, and Silver Edge is his common answer to it.
Her tiny health pool can't tank Lina's magic burst, Fiery Soul's attack speed punishes her low armor despite Untouchable, and Lina clears her creeps fast too.

A Poof combo kills her quickly, rendering Untouchable useless.
Vendetta and Mind Flare both hit hard given her low health and intelligence-hero status, and Spiked Carapace reflects Impetus while stunning her.
His natural Diffusal Blade cuts her movement speed, usually followed by Smoke Screen, and enough hits from Tricks of the Trade matter a lot against her -- unless she's got an early Force Staff.

His burst outdamages her and her creeps, Untouchable is useless since he barely right-clicks, Timber Chain closes the gap or escapes, and he commonly carries Lotus Orb to reflect Enchant and dispel her debuffs.
Battle Trance and Fervor both help him fight through Untouchable.
Untouchable doesn't stop his magic damage, and both nukes cut into Nature's Attendants' healing.
Enchant can't take control of his Chaotic Offering golem.
Windrun's speed and evasion both counter her chase and Impetus threat, Shackleshot punishes standing near her own summon, and Focus Fire negates Untouchable.
Her tiny health pool folds to his burst before Nature's Attendants can heal it back, and since he doesn't right-click, Untouchable does nothing -- an Aether Lens keeps him out of Impetus range too.
Untouchable slows all his attacks including Chaos Strike crits and lets her escape easily -- though Reality Rift's armor shred is still dangerous given her low armor.
Enchant on his creeps cuts both ways, but Aghanim's Shard Little Friends can turn his whole creep army against him, and Impetus bursts his allies before Hand of God saves them.
Impetus punishes a Fire Remnant escape hard, its pure damage ignores Flame Guard, and Enchant can dispel Flame Guard outright.
Untouchable is very effective against his right-click-reliant kit, and Impetus punishes any attempt to run.
Impetus's pure damage isn't blocked by Guardian Angel, and a controlled Satyr Banisher can dispel it outright.
Untouchable and Nature's Attendants make her hard for him to catch or kill with mere spells unless she's already low.
Untouchable pierces spell immunity, so Rage can't stop her from bursting him down while she heals back up.
Untouchable makes it hard for him to land hits even through Black King Bar.
Enchant can control his Boars, cutting his laning and teamfight effectiveness.
Enchant dispels Overpower, her slow kites him in lane and fights, and her range plus Untouchable/Nature's Attendants let her out-harass and out-sustain him.
Her cost-effective dispel prevents easy lane kills and forces him into awkward alternate combos to deal damage.

Ice Blast blocks his healing and regen, including from Armlet, and can kill him outright below the threshold.
Berserker's Call and a follow-up Blade Mail punish a Life Break jump, his high attack speed feeds Counter Helix repeatedly, and his self-damaging health loss makes him easy Culling Blade bait.

Untouchable makes it nearly impossible to stack Burning Spears, and Impetus's pure damage ends his low-health brinkmanship instantly.

Her attack range lets her interrupt him from a safe distance he can't close without Burning Spear's short range.

Rage makes him immune to Burning Spears, and Feast lets him outlast Huskar in a straight fight.
Mirror Image can bait a wasted Life Break, Rip Tide cuts his already-low armor, and Song of the Siren lets the team recover from both his initiation and the damage-over-time.

Stacked Shadow Poison finishes off his generally low health, Disruption turns his own regen and attack speed against him, a common Meteor Hammer lands a heavy stun, and an upgraded Demonic Purge strips his passive through spell immunity for 7 seconds.
He just keeps his distance the whole game -- countering him back needs a Concussive Grenade and a Hurricane Pike ready to dodge Life Break.
Corrosive Haze and Bash of the Deep make short work of his low armor even 1v1.
Jumping on Ursa with Life Break is often suicide -- Fury Swipes bursts him down immediately.
Poison Attack punishes his low-health playstyle, Nethertoxin disables Berserker's Blood, and Corrosive Skin/Viper Strike's slows make jumping on Viper dangerous.
Windrun makes him unhittable with Burning Spears, and Focus Fire's constant damage denies toggling Armlet to regain health.
His low-health playstyle for Berserker's Blood bonuses makes him a prime Reaper's Scythe target.
He's not very mana-reliant so Mana Break barely matters, his small mana pool blunts Mana Void too, and he comes online earlier to take over the game before Anti-Mage farms up.
He jumps in freely, throws off the Spirit Bear, and cuts Lone Druid's Spirit Link regen while dealing near-fatal damage before he can even use his ultimate form.
Burning Spears chip through his low health fast, forcing him to overinvest in regen or leave the lane, his magic-only kit can't stop Huskar, and Life Break usually kills him given his poor mobility.
Time Lapse can't undo Huskar's burn damage-over-time.
His abilities can't handle Huskar 1v1 even with the jump.
Repeated Burning Spear trades negate his passive regen and armor bonus.
His stuns rarely save him once Life Break has locked on, and a full combo only lowers Huskar's health while boosting his attack speed.
He does minimal damage until very late, and Huskar's Burning Spear denies him from ever safely approaching the creep wave.
Sprout doesn't protect him once Life Break has locked on, and even a farmed Nature's Prophet usually can't survive Huskar alone.
His high attack speed counteracts Fire Spirits and easily destroys Supernova.

Laser plus Heat-Seeking Missile burst her down at range before she can fight back.
Flux and Spark Wraith burst her low health quickly, though her Marksmanship bypasses Magnetic Field's evasion.
Snowball, Ice Shards and Tag Team all pin her in place, and Walrus Punch hits hard given her low armor without Marksmanship.
Berserker's Call forces her into melee where Marksmanship shuts off, and her high attack speed feeds Counter Helix.
Hookshot closes the gap instantly, and Power Cogs/Battery Assault trap her close enough to shut off Marksmanship.
Reality Rift disables Marksmanship, and paired with Chaos Bolt he can lock her down long enough to kill her.
Life Break closes the gap and disables Marksmanship, and his sustained damage overwhelms her in a straight fight.
Shapeshift lets him close in and shut off Marksmanship while ignoring her Frost Arrows slow.

Phantom Rush closes distance fast to shut off Marksmanship, Manta dispels Gust, and Diffusal Blade burns the mana she needs for Frost Arrow and Gust.
Meat Hook pulls her in to disable Marksmanship, and following with Rot/Dismember does heavy damage.
Static Link weakens her damage while boosting his, and Plasma Field/Storm Surge keep him close enough to shut off Marksmanship.
Blink Strike gets him close and staying near her unnoticed keeps Marksmanship disabled the whole fight.
A well-timed Dark Pact dispels her slows, Essence Shift weakens her agility scaling permanently, and Pounce/Shadow Dance close in and finish her before she reacts.
Gust pushes him out of Omnislash/Blade Fury range before he can engage.

No stun and a habit of keeping distance makes him perfect Marksmanship bait, and Gust can open him up or cut off Burning Barrage.

Black Hole is hard for him to land on someone who plays at range, and his low health means she kills him fast if he misses -- Manta dispels Malefice, and Demonic Conversion units die in a couple hits to Marksmanship.
His low-health, high-agility playstyle doesn't hold up to sustained Marksmanship procs, and none of his spells particularly bother her.
Metamorphosis can't match her range, Conjure Image illusions die fast to Marksmanship, and his armor/agility stacking makes him take more from it, not less.
A well-timed Gust denies his escape and a silenced Weaver dies fast, and Marksmanship ignores the armor he stacks.
Gust denies his Spell Steal cast, and his low health and lack of tools mean he dies fast once caught; Manta dispels a stolen Fade Bolt.
Gust denies her escape or counter-initiate with Windrun, and Marksmanship's bonus agility shreds her low armor -- though she'll likely carry Shadow Blade/Silver Edge/Monkey King Bar to fight back.

Shapeshift ignores Void's slow entirely, and his single-target kit, barring an Aghanim's Void, struggles against the summoned wolf swarm early-to-mid.
Ensnare/Song of the Siren deny his gank timing day or night, Rip Tide cuts his armor for easier focus, and Mirror Image punishes his single-target reliance.

Doppelganger dispels Void's slow and Phantom Rush counteracts it, Spirit Lance/Diffusal Blade slow him or an ally right back for an escape, and even with Aghanim's there are too many illusions for him to handle.
Warcry's armor, and with Aghanim's Shard its passive component, makes him hard to burst, and God's Strength turns Sven dangerous to engage mid-game.

He's completely helpless if caught in Night Stalker's AoE silence range, and no common item removes it.
None of Puck's usual escapes work once Crippling Fear lands, and she folds fast.
The long night silence denies a Skeleton Walk escape, and his low base health means one Crippling Fear cast alone can kill him at night.
Void disables his Blink Dagger before he can initiate, and he can even blink into the silence radius by mistake to ruin his own combo.
Reducing daytime duration heavily weakens his Aghanim's Scepter upgrade's uptime.
Dark Ascension is one of the best ways to find and silence him hiding in the trees.
Dark Ascension plus a Gem makes him easy to find and kill, and Riki struggles to kill a tanky Night Stalker in return.
Dark Ascension denies Shadow Dance's out-of-vision regen, and Night Stalker's speed without Pounce lets him simply outrun Slark at night -- one of the few heroes who matches Slark's night vision too.

61.note: Greevil's Greed makes her spiderlings extra valuable to farm, and Acid Spray punishes attacking her in lane by chipping spiderlings for free.
Berserker's Call forces her and her spiderlings to attack into big Counter Helix procs.
Ice Blast blocks Insatiable Hunger's lifesteal and Spin Web's regen while quickly killing spiderlings.
His damage reduction blunts most of her and her spiders' damage, and Quill Spray hits every nearby spider at once.
Ion Shell zones her out in lane and kills a grouped spiderling swarm, and Vacuum pulls her straight out of the treeline.
Breathe Fire clears spiderites and damages the spiderling swarm, Dragon Blood's armor and regen mitigates her damage, and Elder Dragon Form's splash punishes the swarm further.

Aftershock-Enchant Totem repeatedly stuns her out of attacking, Echo Slam is massively amplified by a nearby spiderling swarm, and his stun chain denies Insatiable Hunger lifesteal without Black King Bar.
Echo Stomp's long sleep impedes her push timing, Astral Spirit feeds off her spiderling count for huge stats, and Natural Order strips her and the swarm's armor and magic resistance.

Sleight of Fist tanks a spiderling swarm while he clears it, worse with Battle Fury/Maelstrom for wave clear, Flame Guard punishes any spider that gets close, and Fire Remnant escapes her Incapacitating Bite entirely.
X Marks the Spot denies her escape, and Tidebringer clears a nearby spider swarm.

Overwhelming Odds's damage stacks with each unit it hits including a big spiderling swarm, Moment of Courage procs constantly while she's swarmed, and Duel pins her in place long enough for the team to finish her.
Light Strike Array-into-Dragon Slave clears her spider swarm easily, and Laguna Blade's burst can kill her before Insatiable Hunger salvages the fight.
Earthbind denies her escape, Poof clears nearby spiders instantly, and Divided We Stand makes a full clone swarm much harder for her single-target picks to handle.

Death Pulse wipes a grouped spiderling swarm while healing him from her harass, Ghost Shroud blocks her and her spiders' damage until she buys Nullifier or Revenant's Brooch, and Heartstopper Aura regens off every spider kill.
Swashbuckle escapes or kills her spiders, disarming her with Lucky Shot too, Shield Crash clears the swarm, and Rolling Thunder both escapes and initiates on her.
Burrowstrike escapes or initiates on her, and Sand Storm quickly kills any stunned spiderlings caught inside.
Spiderlings feed Necromastery stacks fast and die to Shadowraze easily, and his natural Black King Bar blocks her whole kit while a Eul's-boosted Requiem can kill her before she gets it.
Ball Lightning-Electric Vortex catches her through the trees before she retreats, though the same Ball Lightning also lets him simply flee her until she buys Orchid.
Great Cleave ignores magic resistance to clean up spiderlings fast, his natural Black King Bar blocks her whole kit, and Warcry/God's Strength let him out-damage her outright.
Kraken Shell nearly negates spiderling damage, and Anchor Smash kills a swarm in one or two casts.

Reactive Armor blunts spiderling harass in lane, Timber Chain's mobility ignores Silken Bola's slow unless she's bought Orchid, and his AoE clears both her spiders and the trees she hides in -- a common Lotus Orb also nullifies Silken Bola outright.
His AoE damage shreds her spiderling swarm and his mobility outruns Spin Web's speed, though Aghanim's Spinner's Snare turns her webs into a serious hazard for him.

Insatiable Hunger's damage amp survives Enfeeble's damage reduction, though not the cast-range cut, her single-target kit struggles against a spiderling swarm, and Orchid/Bloodthorn cancel Fiend's Grip outright.
Her single-target kit struggles against a spiderling swarm, Orchid/Bloodthorn deny his Shadow Walk escape, and Aghanim's Spinner's Snare roots him for a gank.

He has no AoE to clear her swarm and must rely on creeps, Spawn Spiderlings kills his creeps and replaces them with her own, Silken Bola cripples him and his creeps, and Bloodthorn denies Hand of God while amplifying her damage.
Her lack of mobility or AoE makes her easy prey for a spiderling swarm.

Her lack of AoE lets Broodmother swarm her freely, and Spawn Spiderlings replaces killed Enchant creeps -- though Untouchable makes actually landing hits hard without Silver Edge, Dagon, or an attack-speed item.

Spawn Spiderlings trades evenly with his Eidolons, an early Bloodthorn, or Abyssal even through Black King Bar, cancels Black Hole, Silken Bola punishes his lack of true-strike items, and Aghanim's Spinner's Snare disrupts his initiation and Blink Dagger entirely.

Web speed lets her hit-and-run effectively, Silken Bola causes misses that get her swarmed fast, and a Diffusal Blade drains the mana she needs for Mana Shield since Medusa rarely carries Black King Bar.

Sticking close to her own spiderling swarm at high speed makes Sacred Arrow hard to land, Orchid/Bloodthorn deny both Leap and Moonlight Shadow escapes, and Aghanim's Spinner's Snare disrupts a Moonlight Shadow-Sacred Arrow combo.
Sprout can't protect him once she's placed a web, his low mobility is defenseless against Silken Bola, and Aghanim's Spinner's Snare denies his Silver Edge ambush or escape entirely.

Her single-target kit struggles against a spiderling swarm without Battle Fury, Spin Web lets Broodmother escape before a crit lands, Silken Bola cripples an all-physical hero hard, and Aghanim's Spinner's Snare disrupts a Phantom Strike engage or escape.
He's helpless against her kit and takes real damage from spiderlings in lane whenever Shrapnel is down.
Spiderlings melt Living Armor almost instantly, though Eyes in the Forest's vision can be dangerous for her in return.

Lightning Bolt punishes roaming hard as he scales, and Thundergod's Wrath reveals him regardless of position.
Shadow Walk closes his range advantage, Jinada's slow and burst hit hard early, and Track's speed bonus plus a Shadow Blade counter makes him easy to finish off.
Track keeping him locked down denies his early Vendetta ganking window, and his high armor/regen make him a good Shuriken Toss target.

Track keeps vision on him to deny hooks on Bounty Hunter or allies, Shadow Walk dodges Rot's chase, and a well-placed Shuriken Toss cancels Dismember from range.
Track reveals her through Meld, letting him and his team gank her repeatedly until Black King Bar or the Meld-dispel talent.
